title: Passkeys via WebAuthn
summary: Local public accounts can register device passkeys for phishing-resistant sign-in and for confirming sensitive account changes. Password sign-in remains available, including authenticator-app codes when enabled. Passkeys are bound to the application host from APP_URL.
changes: Add laravel/passkeys with relying party ID and allowed origins derived from APP_URL for the live MyAPES Account host.
Let local accounts register, list, and remove named passkeys on the profile after recent password or passkey confirmation.
Offer passkey sign-in on Public Login while keeping password (and authenticator codes when enrolled) as a fallback.
Allow confirming sensitive account actions with a registered passkey as well as with the account password.
Email the account when a passkey is added or removed, and document Laragon HTTPS requirements for local WebAuthn.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39.x Account security line: WebAuthn passkeys after custom TOTP (0.39.5).
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Passkey enrolment is not offered for Cloudron OIDC-only staff accounts.
Local WebAuthn ceremonies need a secure context (HTTPS Laragon or equivalent); plain http://127.0.0.1 is not supported by browsers.
Changing the relying party ID (APP_URL host) invalidates existing passkeys.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The passkeys table becomes unused after rollback and can remain without blocking password or authenticator sign-in.
